parameters.query:
SELECT 
  cc.inventory_number,
  cc.serial_number,
  cc.glpi_data->>'name' AS computer_name,
  (SELECT c.name FROM glpi_cache c WHERE c.entity_type = 'manufacturer' AND c.glpi_id = (cc.glpi_data->>'manufacturers_id')::int LIMIT 1) AS manufacturer_name,
  (SELECT c.name FROM glpi_cache c WHERE c.entity_type = 'model' AND c.glpi_id = (cc.glpi_data->>'computermodels_id')::int LIMIT 1) AS model_name,
  (SELECT c.name FROM glpi_cache c WHERE c.entity_type = 'processor' AND c.glpi_id = ((cc.glpi_data->'_component_ids'->>'processor')::int) LIMIT 1) AS processor_name,
  (SELECT c.name FROM glpi_cache c WHERE c.entity_type = 'memory' AND c.glpi_id = ((cc.glpi_data->'_component_ids'->>'memory')::int) LIMIT 1) AS memory_name,
  (SELECT c.name FROM glpi_cache c WHERE c.entity_type = 'storage' AND c.glpi_id = ((cc.glpi_data->'_component_ids'->>'storage')::int) LIMIT 1) AS storage_name,
  cc.glpi_data->>'comment' AS comment
FROM created_computers cc
WHERE cc.glpi_computer_id = $1;
